name: Cell, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth
author: AndroUnderTheHood
description: Cellular modem, SIMs, serving and neighbour cells (band, frequency, PCI, RSRP/RSRQ/SINR, timing-advance distance), Wi-Fi hardware/connection/scan/channel use/saved networks, Bluetooth adapter/paired/nearby devices, active networks and ping. Live signal graph with event log and CSV export. Controls: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, mobile data and airplane mode on/off, Wi-Fi connect/disconnect/forget, Bluetooth connect/disconnect.
